messages:
Noah (FinOps): Heads-up: spotted 52 invoices in today's NetSuite export missing Canada tax jurisdiction/tax rate rows. Looks like tax lines stripped during webhook retry batching. Putting here so we don't re-import bad rows.

Ivy (Payments Eng): Can you paste examples? Might be related to the recent retry/compact change to webhook payloads.

Noah (FinOps): Examples: inv_CA_07A1, inv_CA_07A2. Log snippet: 
```
2026-05-03T14:03:12Z WARN webhook-retry compacted payload id=evt_9 reason=payload-truncated fields_removed=[metadata,tax_details]
2026-05-03T14:03:13Z INFO invoice-builder created invoice=inv_CA_07A1 lines=3 tax_lines=0
```
It shows tax_details removed before invoice construction.

integrations-bot: Alert: webhook.compaction.removed_tax_details count=52 window=2026-05-03T14:00Z-14:10Z. Created INC-2026-3789.

Samir (Billing Ops): I paused the NetSuite import for the 14:00 batch. Please DO NOT run the re-import. Also marking affected ledgers as pending_review.

Ivy (Payments Eng): Quick context: we shipped retry-compact v2.0 which attempts to shrink retry payloads by dropping non-essential fields. The filter mistakenly treated tax_details as non-essential when event.type==invoice.finalized. Hotfix incoming to stop dropping tax_details and treat metadata.tax_jurisdiction as required. PR: payments/webhook-retry#512. ETA deploy ~1.5h after tests.

Noah (FinOps): For remediation we need: (1) export list of affected invoice IDs; (2) replay DLQ for events tagged "compaction-drop" with checksum-compare; (3) generate corrected NetSuite CSV and re-import idempotently. I'll export invoice list to gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-05-03-ca-tax-missing.csv

Samir (Billing Ops): I'll prepare a corrected export script that pulls canonical invoice objects directly from invoicedb instead of the compacted webhook payload. Command: 
```bash
python tools/generate_ns_export.py --source invoicedb --invoice-list gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-05-03-ca-tax-missing.csv --out gs://redwood-finance/backfills/ns-repair-2026-05-03-ca.csv --validate-tax
```
I'll validate tax_code and jurisdiction before any re-import.

Ivy (Payments Eng): Replay CLI (dry-run first): 
```bash
./bin/replay_dlq --tag compaction-drop --since 2026-05-03T14:00:00Z --to 2026-05-03T14:15:00Z --dry-run --checksum-compare --skip-posted
```
We'll only perform live replay after dry-run confirms tax_lines would be applied. Also adding metric webhook.compaction_drop_rate and alerting on >5/min.

integrations-bot: INC-2026-3789 updated: assignee=Ivy (Payments Eng), status=investigating, severity=medium.

Noah (FinOps): Important: some of these invoices already posted & paid. Samir please flag any paid invoices for manual tax adjustment review after replay; we may need adjustments rather than refunds.

Samir (Billing Ops): Flagging paid invoices (17/52) for manual AR review and will prepare tax-adjustment plan. I'll also coordinate with CS if customers ask about line-item changes on PDFs.

Ivy (Payments Eng): Hotfix merged and deployed to staging. Adding a regression test to ensure tax_details preserved for invoice.* events. Will deploy to prod in ~45m after smoke tests.

Noah (FinOps): Thanks. Owners: Ivy - patch + replay; Samir - prepare corrected export and AR manual review; Noah - run reconciliation after re-import. Please post dry-run results here before live replay.

deploy-bot: Deploy payments/webhook-retry v2.0.1 started at 2026-05-03T14:28:00Z; target: webhook-retry-prod.

Ivy (Payments Eng): Dry-run finished: 52 events would re-apply tax lines for 52 invoices, no checksum mismatches for posted=false. Posting dry-run log: gs://redwood-finance/logs/replay-dryrun-2026-05-03.txt

Samir (Billing Ops): Corrected NS CSV generated and validated. Holding final import until replay completes.

Noah (FinOps): Good. Once replay and re-import are done, I'll run revenue/tax reconciliation and confirm there are no downstream rounding or tax-reporting issues. Add this to the finance retro: do not drop tax-related fields during any compaction.
